BOLT.NAME: Bolt
BOLT.LR: A bolt of lightning from the sky strikes down any single military unit.

SENTINEL.NAME: Sentinel
SENTINEL.LR: Target your or an ally’s Town Center, Village Center, or Fortress to protect it with stone guardians.

LURE.NAME: Lure
LURE.LR: Target a location to erect a special stone which draws animals to it and spawns chickens. The Lure summons more food in later ages, and Villagers can drop off food at the Lure.

RESTORATION.NAME: Restoration
RESTORATION.LR: Target a location to heal units and repair buildings, siege weapons, and ships belonging to you or your allies.

CEASE_FIRE.NAME: Ceasefire
CEASE_FIRE.LR: Target anywhere on the map to prevent every player from fighting and slow the construction of ranged fortifications for a short period of time.

PESTILENCE.NAME: Pestilence
PESTILENCE.LR: Target an enemy town to infect it with plague. The Pestilence prevents buildings from firing projectiles and slows unit production.

CURSE.NAME: Curse
CURSE.LR: Target near enemy soldiers to turn several of their units into Pigs.

BRONZE.NAME: Bronze
BRONZE.LR: Target a location to encase your soldiers, myth units, and ships with bronze, reducing their vulnerability in combat.

UNDERWORLD_PASSAGE.NAME: Underworld Passage
UNDERWORLD_PASSAGE.LR: Select two locations on the map to create entrances to the Underworld through which units can move.

PLENTY.NAME: Plenty
PLENTY.LR: Select a location to erect this great Vault. The bounty of the gods will flow into your coffers as long as you control it.

EARTHQUAKE.NAME: Earthquake
EARTHQUAKE.LR: Target a location to shatter nearby enemy buildings. The epicenter of the earthquake inflicts the most damage.

LIGHTNING_STORM.NAME: Lightning Storm
LIGHTNING_STORM.LR: Target a location to call down an electric storm from Olympus whose power increases over time. Strong against groups of enemy units.

VISION.NAME: Vision
VISION.LR: Target a region of the map to be temporarily revealed.

RAIN.NAME: Rain
RAIN.LR: Target anywhere to make all of your Villagers gather Food from Farms faster, and fishing ships gather Food from fish faster.

PROSPERITY.NAME: Prosperity
PROSPERITY.LR: Target anywhere to make all of your Villagers and Trade Caravans gather Gold faster.

SHIFTING_SANDS.NAME: Shifting Sands
SHIFTING_SANDS.LR: Target your own or allied units, and then target the location where you wish to teleport them.

PLAGUE_OF_SERPENTS.NAME: Plague of Serpents
PLAGUE_OF_SERPENTS.LR: Target a location on the map where dangerous Serpents will rise from the ground or sea and protect that area from your enemies.

ECLIPSE.NAME: Eclipse
ECLIPSE.LR: Target anywhere on the map to turn day to night, improving the abilities of your myth units and increasing the rate at which your Monuments generate Favor.

ANCESTORS.NAME: Ancestors
ANCESTORS.LR: Target a location to awaken ancestral soldiers or ships to fight again for a short time.

LOCUST_SWARM.NAME: Locust Swarm
LOCUST_SWARM.LR: Target a path of destruction. Summons a plague of locusts that attacks enemy units and buildings, devouring Farms, livestock, and Berry Bushes.

CITADEL.NAME: Citadel
CITADEL.LR: Select a Town Center belonging to you or an ally to transform it into a mighty, defensive Citadel, which trains units and researches technologies faster.

METEOR.NAME: Meteor
METEOR.LR: Target an enemy area to bombard with burning rocks from the heavens. Strong against buildings, moderately effective against units.

TORNADO.NAME: Tornado
TORNADO.LR: Target near an enemy to send a cyclone that will suck their buildings and units up into the sky – but stay out of its way.

SON_OSIRIS.NAME: Son of Osiris
SON_OSIRIS.LR: Target your Pharaoh to transform him into a super-empowering, lightning-wielding demigod.

DWARVEN_MINE.NAME: Dwarven Mine
DWARVEN_MINE.LR: Select a location to create a new Gold Mine that has more Gold and is gathered faster if used in later ages.

GREAT_HUNT.NAME: Great Hunt
GREAT_HUNT.LR: Target a group of wild animals to greatly multiply their numbers. If there are none, Odin will summon a small amount. Gets more powerful each age.

SPY.NAME: Spy
SPY.LR: Target an enemy unit to secretly see what it sees.

GULLINBURSTI.NAME: Gullinbursti
GULLINBURSTI.LR: Target one of your Town Centers (or your allies') to summon and command Freyr's golden boar Gullinbursti to defend the area. Gullinbursti becomes stronger each age.

HEALING_SPRING.NAME: Healing Spring
HEALING_SPRING.LR: Target a location on the map to create a spring that will heal all nearby friendly units. The spring cannot be destroyed, but can be taken over by enemy forces.

UNDERMINE.NAME: Undermine
UNDERMINE.LR: Target a path of destruction along which to damage enemy buildings. Walls and towers instantly collapse, and other buildings take considerable damage.

FOREST_FIRE.NAME: Forest Fire
FOREST_FIRE.LR: Target a forest to burn it to smoldering embers, damaging nearby units and buildings.

ASGARDIAN_BASTION.NAME: Asgardian Bastion
ASGARDIAN_BASTION.LR: Target a location to summon a foundation that will materialize into a spectral Hill Fort when fully constructed. Builds faster in later ages.

FLAMING_WEAPONS.NAME: Flaming Weapons
FLAMING_WEAPONS.LR: Target anywhere on the map to cause the weapons of all of your human soldiers and ships to burst into flame, increasing their attack for a short period of time.

FROST.NAME: Frost
FROST.LR: Target near enemy units to freeze them solid for a short period of time. Frozen units cannot move, but are very hard to kill.

WALKING_WOODS.NAME: Walking Woods
WALKING_WOODS.LR: Target near a forest to animate the trees to attack nearby enemies. The animated trees are strong against buildings and decent against units.

TEMPEST.NAME: Tempest
TEMPEST.LR: Target a location to unleash a vicious hailstorm, damaging enemies and heavily slowing their attacks and movement.

RAGNAROK.NAME: Ragnarok
RAGNAROK.LR: Target anywhere on the map to permanently transform all of your Gatherers and Dwarves into mighty Heroes of Ragnarok.

FIMBULWINTER.NAME: Fimbulwinter
FIMBULWINTER.LR: Target anywhere on the map to summon packs of ferocious wolves to attack enemy Town Centers.

NIDHOGG.NAME: Nidhogg
NIDHOGG.LR: Select a location to summon the mighty Norse dragon from his delve beneath the earth.

INFERNO.NAME: Inferno
INFERNO.LR: Target a fiery path of destruction. The great wolf Fenrir will emerge and charge, engulfing enemies in flames before erupting into an apocalyptic inferno of flame and ruin.

DECONSTRUCTION.NAME: Deconstruction
DECONSTRUCTION.LR: Target an enemy building to deconstruct it. The target player will get their resources back but lose the building.

SHOCKWAVE.NAME: Shockwave
SHOCKWAVE.LR: Target a location on the map to send enemy units flying, stunning them for a few seconds.

GAIA_FOREST.NAME: Gaia Forest
GAIA_FOREST.LR: Select a location to grow a Gaia Forest. Villagers gather wood faster from Gaia Trees.

CARNIVORA.NAME: Carnivora
CARNIVORA.LR: Spawns a giant plant that pulls humans and ships in and devours them.

SPIDER_LAIR.NAME: Spider Lair
SPIDER_LAIR.LR: Target an area to place spider eggs which will hatch and burrow. The spiders will devour enemy human soldiers that cross through the area, but eggs can be destroyed before they hatch.

VALOR.NAME: Valor
VALOR.LR: Target one of your human units to convert it into a hero and heal it fully.

CHAOS.NAME: Chaos
CHAOS.LR: Target a group of enemy units to make it temporarily hostile to all.

TRAITOR.NAME: Traitor
TRAITOR.LR: Target an enemy unit to convert it to your side.

HESPERIDES_TREE.NAME: Hesperides Tree
HESPERIDES_TREE.LR: Select a location to create a tree that summons some Dryad myth units and can train more.

IMPLODE.NAME: Implode
IMPLODE.LR: Target a location to do massive damage to nearby units and buildings. This is more powerful when cast near a large number of enemy units.

TARTARIAN_GATE.NAME: Tartarian Gate
TARTARIAN_GATE.LR: Hekate opens a gate to the Underworld that unleashes creatures hostile to all. The gate will destroy any buildings in the vicinity when it is placed.

VORTEX.NAME: Vortex
VORTEX.LR: Target a location to transport all of your military units there.

THE_PEACH_BLOSSOM_SPRING.NAME: The Peach Blossom Spring
THE_PEACH_BLOSSOM_SPRING.LR: Target a location to create the Peach Blossom Spring, whose resource stockpile grows over time. The Peach Blossom Spring's resources are gathered very quickly, but its stockpile stops growing once a villager starts gathering from it.

CREATION.NAME: Creation
CREATION.LR: Target a location to create a number of Clay Peasants that last for a couple of minutes. Spawns more Peasants in later ages.

PROSPEROUS_SEEDS.NAME: Prosperous Seeds
PROSPEROUS_SEEDS.LR: Target 2 Farms to sow the seeds of prosperity. They will produce food faster, heal nearby villagers, and make friendly units on them invisible.

PROSPEROUS_SEEDS2.NAME: Target 2 Farms to sow the seeds of prosperity. They will produce food faster and heal nearby villagers.

LIGHTNING_WEAPONS.NAME: Lightning Weapons
LIGHTNING_WEAPONS.LR: Target a location to conduct lightning into the weapons of all of your human soldiers, heroes and ships, granting their attacks a chance to stun enemies.

EARTH_WALL.NAME: Earth Wall
EARTH_WALL.LR: Raises earthen walls to surround the targeted area.

EARTH_WALL2.NAME: Target a friendly building to surround it with earthen walls. Allies can pass through them, but enemies cannot.

VANISH.NAME: Vanish
VANISH.LR: Target a group of friendly units to make them invisible for a short time. Attacking will reveal their position.

FOREST_PROTECTION.NAME: Forest Protection
FOREST_PROTECTION.LR: Target a friendly building to protect the surrounding area with Goumang's wood power, which roots enemies and heals allied units.

DROUGHT_LAND.NAME: Drought
DROUGHT_LAND.LR: Target an area to spread drought, which makes enemy buildings far easier to destroy, units easier to kill, and prevents all construction and repairs.

VENOM_BEAST.NAME: Fei Beasts
VENOM_BEAST.LR: Target a location to spawn poisonous Fei Beasts that spread infection to enemies.

BLAZING_PRAIRIE.NAME: Blazing Prairie
BLAZING_PRAIRIE.LR: Target a location to open the heavens and set the world on fire. Everything will burn.

YINGLONGS_WRATH.NAME: Yinglong's Wrath
YINGLONGS_WRATH.LR: Target a location to summon Yinglong, the legendary rain and lightning dragon of China.

GREAT_FLOOD.NAME: Great Flood
GREAT_FLOOD.LR: Target a path of destruction for a cataclysmic flood that sweeps away units and annihilates buildings.

TITAN_GATE.NAME: Titan Gate
TITAN_GATE.LR: Target a location to place a Titan Gate. Once your Villagers finish clearing the debris, a Titan will emerge.

ZEUS_BLESS.NAME: Blessing of Zeus
ZEUS_BLESS.LR: Target Arkantos to transform him into a super-powered, demi-god.

DECONSTRUCT_WONDER.NAME: Deconstruct Wonder
DECONSTRUCT_WONDER.LR: Target an enemy Wonder to reverse time on it and unbuild it.

SEED_OF_GAIA.NAME: Seed of Gaia
SEED_OF_GAIA.LR: Target a Gaia Pool to grow a Gaia Summoning Tree there.

GOATUNHEIM.NAME: Goatunheim
GOATUNHEIM.LR: Target anywhere on the map to permanently transform all units into tasty Goats. BAAAAAAH!

PANDATOPIA.NAME: Pandatopia
PANDATOPIA.LR: Target anywhere on the map to permanently transform all units into Pandas.

SOLAR_SHIELD.NAME: Solar Shield
SOLAR_SHIELD.LR: Target a unit to make it temporarily nearly invulnerable.

NEW_MOON.NAME: New Moon
NEW_MOON.LR: Target a building to obtain all currently available technologies there for free and cause military units to train faster for a short duration.

NEW_MOON2.NAME: Target a building to obtain the three most expensive technologies currently available there for free and cause military units to train faster for a short duration.

KUSANAGI.NAME: Kusanagi
KUSANAGI.LR: Target a location for Susanoo to cast down his sword, Kusanagi. The sword damages nearby enemies and summons a riptide that blasts them skyward.

SWAMPLAND.NAME: Swampland
SWAMPLAND.LR: Target a location to create a temporary swamp infested with Kappa that will leap out of the water and drown enemy human soldiers.

SWAMPLAND2.LR: Target a location to create a temporary swamp that slows enemy units, reducing their speed over time.

SHRINE_OF_THE_HUNT.NAME: Shrine of the Hunt
SHRINE_OF_THE_HUNT.LR: Target a Shrine to transform it into a Shrine of the Hunt, periodically spawning huntable deer as well as friendly wolves that defend the area.

GOSHINBOKU.NAME: Goshinboku
GOSHINBOKU.LR: Target a location to summon a Goshinboku tree. The tree's blessing resurrects the owner's myth units as they fall in combat.

SHOGUN.NAME: Shogun
SHOGUN.LR: Target a Daimyo to transform him into an immensely powerful Shogun, who summons Samurai while he fights.

THUNDER_BURST.NAME: Thunder Burst
THUNDER_BURST.LR: Target a location to unleash earth-shaking shockwaves. Raijin strikes his den-den daiko drums, causing expanding rings of lightning to damage and stun enemies.

SMITING_GUST.NAME: Smiting Gust
SMITING_GUST.LR: Target a direction in which to unleash an immense gust of wind, blasting military units across the map.

DIVINE_SLASH.NAME: Divine Slash
DIVINE_SLASH.LR: Target a path of destruction. Takemikazuchi will cleave the earth with a colossal katana slash, inflicting massive damage to units and stunning any survivors.

SACRED_GATE.NAME: Sacred Gate
SACRED_GATE.LR: Target a location to erect a great Torii Gate which makes your God Powers cheaper and immediately enables you to invoke them once again for free.

DRAGON_TYPHOON.NAME: Dragon Typhoon
DRAGON_TYPHOON.LR: Target a path of destruction. Watatsumi will descend in dragon form and erupt into a swirling typhoon, tearing through everything in his path.

HACHIMANS_BLESSING.NAME: Hachiman's Blessing
HACHIMANS_BLESSING.LR: Target Harumoto or a Daimyo to grant Hachiman's blessing, making them much stronger.

WITHER.NAME: Wither
WITHER.LR: Target a location to wither berries, farms, and trees, rendering the terrain sterile for a short period of time.

ARCADIAN_MEADOW.NAME: Arcadian Meadow
ARCADIAN_MEADOW.LR: Target an area to temporarily turn it into a peaceful meadow. Units and buildings inside the meadow cannot attack.

COMMUNAL_HEARTH.NAME: Communal Hearth
COMMUNAL_HEARTH.LR: Summon a hearth that increases Villager gather rate and converts enemy units.

UNDERWORLD_INVASION.NAME: Underworld Invasion
UNDERWORLD_INVASION.LR: Sacrifice all your Town and Village Centers to resurrect fallen military and Myth units. Settlements cannot be repopulated for some time.

UNDERWORLD_INVASION_ALT.LR: Sacrifice all standing Town and Village Centers to resurrect up to 25 + 25 per Town Center up to a maximum of 125 fallen human soldiers. Settlements cannot be repopulated for some time.

MONOLITH_STRIKE.NAME: Monolith Strike
MONOLITH_STRIKE.LR: Targets nearby units with a splashing burst of water, dealing tremendous damage.

CURSEOFRA.NAME: Curse of Ra
CURSEOFRA.LR: Target anywhere on the map to summon packs of Mummies and Minions to attack enemy Town Centers.

OBSIDIAN_MIRROR.NAME: Obsidian Mirror
OBSIDIAN_MIRROR.LR: Target any player to secretly copy their Archaic Age God Power.

TAILWIND.NAME: Tailwind
TAILWIND.LR: Target a group of friendly units to boost their movement speed for a short duration.

BLOOD_PACT.NAME: Blood Pact
BLOOD_PACT.LR: Target any unit to grant it immense power for a short duration. When the effect ends, the unit dies, granting you Favor.

AGAVE_BLOOM.NAME: Agave Bloom
AGAVE_BLOOM.LR: Target a location to spawn a sacred Agave. Gather it for Food or let its sacred energy heal your nearby units.

INFESTATION.NAME: Infestation
INFESTATION.LR: Target a location to summon an Infested Nest that periodically spawns Scorpions that obey your commands.

LULLABY.NAME: Lullaby
LULLABY.LR: Target a group of enemies to put them to sleep. Any damage dealt to sleeping units will wake them up immediately.

EARTH_MONSTER.NAME: Earth Monster
EARTH_MONSTER.LR: Target a location to summon Tlaltecuhtli, the Earth Monster. It erupts from the ground repeatedly to swallow groups of units, trapping them underground before regurgitating survivors.

STARFALL.NAME: Starfall
STARFALL.LR: Target a location to bombard enemies with falling stars. Tzitzimitl star demons occasionally emerge from the craters to fight for you.

PURGE.NAME: Purge
PURGE.LR: Target an enemy military unit to mark it for sacrifice. The unit is suspended in the air, and after a short delay, all nearby enemies of the same type are destroyed, up to a total of 1400 resource value.

PILLAR_OF_TLALOCAN.NAME: Pillar of Tlálocan
PILLAR_OF_TLALOCAN.LR: Target a location to call down the Pillar of Tlálocan, obliterating fortifications on impact. The statue remains to defend the area with water strikes until destroyed.

CORRUPTED_GROUND.NAME: Corrupted Ground
CORRUPTED_GROUND.LR: Target an area to corrupt the earth. Defeated enemies here will be reborn as vile abominations that fight for you.

VOLCANO.NAME: Volcano
VOLCANO.LR: Target a location to raise a mighty Volcano. It obliterates buildings as it rises, and bombards the surrounding area with molten rock.

NEW_FIRE_CEREMONY.NAME: New Fire Ceremony
NEW_FIRE_CEREMONY.LR: Garrison 3 Livestock at the Great Temple and use this command to Devote them.\nReward: For 60 seconds, Devoting Settlers earns more Favor and livestock fatten faster.

NEW_FIRE_CEREMONY_ACTIVE.LR: For 60 seconds, Devoting Settlers earns more Favor and livestock fatten faster.

NEW_FIRE_CEREMONY_NOTIFICATION.NAME: You are performing the New Fire Ceremony.

COSMIC_GUARD.NAME: Cosmic Guard
COSMIC_GUARD.LR: Garrison 12 non-scout human soldiers at the Great Temple and use this command to Devote them.\nReward: Spawns 4 myth units (2 from Age IV and 2 from Age III).

COSMIC_GUARD_NOTIFICATION.NAME: You have used the Cosmic Guard power.

WOLF_PACK.NAME: Wolf Pack
WOLF_PACK.LR: Target a location on the map where dangerous wolves will spawn and protect that area from your enemies.
